title: ResourceSearchResponse rows depend on requested ResultFormat
answers: Why does my search-index existence check miss rows / always return empty?
How do I check if a ResourceSearchRequest returned any matches?
FIELD_VALUES search returns rows but rsp.Results.Rows is empty
Supporting both old and new search servers for row-count checks
body:
Symptom: a Search() existence/uniqueness check against the resource index silently finds 0 matches even though a matching resource exists, when the request uses ResultFormat FIELD_VALUES.
Root cause: ResourceSearchResponse stores hits in different places depending on ResultFormat — RESOURCE_TABLE (and UNSPECIFIED, for older search servers) puts rows in rsp.Results.Rows, while FIELD_VALUES puts them directly in rsp.Rows. Code that only checks rsp.Results.Rows misses FIELD_VALUES hits.
Fix pattern: branch on rsp.GetResultFormat() to pick the right row slice (see searchResponseHasRows), and explicitly set ResultFormat on the request plus a minimal Fields projection (e.g. just resource.SEARCH_FIELD_NAME) when you only need presence/absence, not full field data.
Constraints: apply this whenever writing new Search() callers that only care whether results exist; default/UNSPECIFIED must still be treated as RESOURCE_TABLE for backward compatibility with older search servers that don't set ResultFormat.
applies: Any code calling resourcepb ResourceIndexClient.Search and inspecting ResourceSearchResponse rows/results
says: Resource search never finds matches despite database having valid records
Existence check returns zero always in search index
Search servers return row data in incompatible locations
Verify search found results fails upgrading server version
Row count check breaks across different search server versions
search: ResourceSearchResponse rows exist in different fields per result format: RESOURCE_TABLE/UNSPECIFIED in rsp.Results.Rows, FIELD_VALUES directly in rsp.Rows; code checking only Results.Rows finds zero matches when the response uses FIELD_VALUES despite TotalHits > 0. Fix: branch on GetResultFormat() to select the correct row slice (see pkg/storage/unified/apistore/prepare.go:searchResponseHasRows). Set ResultFormat and minimal Fields projection when only checking existence, treating UNSPECIFIED as RESOURCE_TABLE for older server compatibility.
